subject: executor: fix data race in the sortexec (#52417)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent; only `pkg/executor/sortexec/sort.go` changes. Reordering `fetchChunksParallel()` to start the fetcher after all `Parallel.workers` are initialized prevents spill paths from observing partially-initialized workers, and removing disk closes from `generateResult()` avoids redundant/double-close of spill files (now handled by `SortExec.Close()` via `spillHelper.close()`). Checked the spill/worker/fetcher/Close coordination for hangs, races, and cleanup ordering; no remaining Blocker/High issues found. Upstream `master` retains the same worker-before-fetcher ordering and lacks the removed disk-close block, suggesting no later revert/fix was needed for these hunks.
